title: Sensorimotor environment but not task rule reconfigures population dynamics in rhesus monkey posterior parietal cortex

notes: The dataset consists of several hundred single-neuron recordings from multiple rhesus monkeys performing visually guided reaching tasks. It was designed to test whether changes in the environment (sensorimotor feedback) and changes in abstract rule context engage shared or distinct population-level neural mechanisms in the PPC.
